claims: C1 a message is converted into a sequence of tokens before being passed into the multimodal language model
C2 a token is an atomic unit of text or multimodal data, such as a word or piece of a word
C3 for the purposes of this document, tokens are an idiosyncratic unit for measuring the length of model inputs and outputs
C4 models typically have a fixed maximum number of tokens they can input or output in a single request
